subject: Tooling license renewals coordination — GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Tooling license renewals coordination — GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian

Team —

We're coming up on a cluster of renewals across our core developer tooling stack (GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains All Products Pack, Atlassian Cloud: Jira + Confluence). I pulled the contracts and the key facts are below: 

- GitHub Enterprise: renewal window opens 2026-07-01, ~420 seats (approx 390 active developers + 30 contractors).
- JetBrains: renewal window 2026-07-15, 150 seats.
- Atlassian: renewal window 2026-07-01, Jira + Confluence, 450 user tier (we're at 432 active).

Primary asks:
- Confirm final headcounts by EOD 2026-04-13 so we can lock target term start 2026-07-01 where possible.
- Consolidate negotiation: Monica, can you coordinate vendor outreach and push for cross-vendor bundling discounts or payment-term alignments?
- Finance: Marcus, please confirm PO timing/limits and whether we can sign a single master agreement + individual SOWs for vendors.

I've attached the current quotes and a provisional seat list (team-seat-list-2026.csv). Suggest a 30-min sync tomorrow (2026-04-13) at 10:00 PT to agree next steps. If that doesn't work, propose 16:00 PT.

Attachments: GitHub_Enterprise_Quote_2026-04-12.pdf; JetBrains_quote_Q3_2026.pdf; Atlassian_renewal_summary_2026.pdf

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Director, IT Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tooling license renewals coordination — GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian

Lauren — thanks for the summary. I'll take point on vendor conversations. Quick notes from my outreach so far: 

- GitHub (Sarah Lee): initial quote attached. They're open to a 8–12% committed-use discount if we consolidate with Atlassian and sign a 12-month term. They asked for confirmed active seat counts.
- JetBrains (contact: licensing@jetbrains.com): historically less flexible on per-seat discounts but may offer tiered pricing if we increase to 200 seats or extend to 24 months.
- Atlassian (renewals team): they offer cloud credits for cross-product bundles; if we maintain >420 users across Jira/Confluence, we can get a 10% uplift in support credits.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Lock headcounts by EOD tomorrow (2026-04-13). I'll compile final usage data and send to vendor contacts.
2) Ask all vendors for quotes with identical term start 2026-07-01 and net-30 payment.
3) Ask GitHub & Atlassian for a consolidated commercial concession (they often honor a small additional discount for simultaneous renewals).

I'll schedule the 10:00 PT sync now and invite vendor reps to join if available.

- Monica
Account Executive, Vendor Ops (internal)
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Sarah.Lee@github.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-12T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: GitHub Enterprise quote for Redwood Inference

Hi Lauren/Monica —

Thanks for the heads up. Attached is the preliminary GitHub Enterprise quote (GitHub_Enterprise_Quote_2026-04-12.pdf). Highlights:
- List price for 420 seats (GitHub Enterprise Cloud): $168,000/year
- Committed usage pricing we can offer: 10% discount (net $151,200/year) for a 12-month contract if signed before 2026-06-15.
- Additional 2% concession available if Atlassian renews concurrently (we can include a one-time credit).

We need a final seat roster and billing entity to finalize the DocuSign. We can accept a PO and then follow with a signed agreement — standard process.

Let me know if you'd like me to include Atlassian's renewals rep on the call later today.

Regards,
Sarah Lee
Enterprise Sales
GitHub, Inc.
sarah.lee@github.com

(Attachment: GitHub_Enterprise_Quote_2026-04-12.pdf)
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: sarah.lee@github.com, licensing@jetbrains.com, renewals@atlassian.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-13T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tooling license renewals coordination — consolidated quote request

Sarah / JetBrains / Atlassian team —

Thanks Sarah. To streamline procurement and minimize administrative overhead, could each vendor provide: 

1) An updated quote that matches a term start of 2026-07-01 and net-30 payment terms.
2) A line-item breakdown for seats, professional support (if applicable), and any one-time setup/termination fees.
3) Confirmation whether discounts are stackable if we sign all three by 2026-06-15.
4) Preferred DocuSign recipient and whether you accept a single PO covering multiple vendors (if not, please confirm separate PO workflow).

Attached: team-seat-list-2026.csv (current per-team allocations). Marcus, please confirm billing entity & PO limits so vendors can include payment instructions.

We'd like an updated consolidated quote by 2026-04-16 to keep negotiating leverage and allow Finance time to process.

Best,
Lauren

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, sarah.lee@github.com
Cc: finance@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-14T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tooling license renewals coordination — PO & billing info

All —

Finance is aligned to proceed with a consolidated purchasing approach provided each vendor sends a final quote with explicit line items and the DocuSign envelope references the Redwood billing entity below. We will issue a single PO per vendor (we cannot accept one PO for multiple third parties).

Billing details:
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Payable
123 Innovation Way
San Francisco, CA 94107
Tax ID: 94-XXXXXXX

Please route the final DocuSign and invoice to finance@redwood.ai. I've attached our PO template for vendors to use (PO_template_Redwood_2026.docx). Once quotes arrive, Finance can issue POs within 3 business days for amounts under $200k. Anything above will need VP approval — I'll flag it immediately.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Finance
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
